This conclusion was based on partial information from earlier snippets and not corroborated by a reliable source. The Persée article explicitly identifies him as "architecte de la cour de Henri III" (court architect), which is a distinct and less formal title. The Planner should have waited for more concrete evidence or explicitly prioritized verifying the title from multiple credible sources before making this assumption. This early misstep led to an incorrect line of inquiry and confusion regarding his role.
